def transform(grid):
    # Duplicate the outer rows and columns; retain the center row/column once.
    rows = [0, 0, 1, 2, 2] if len(grid) == 3 else list(range(len(grid)))
    cols = [0, 0, 1, 2, 2] if len(grid[0]) == 3 else list(range(len(grid[0])))
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
